shadows.name: settings-dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate preferences from the reading workspace.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover and selection changes; reduced motion overrides apply.

narrative.overview: The interface is a practical file library. Navigation and settings use a stable sans-serif face, while the note itself honors the reader’s chosen typography. File rows, subtle dividers, and clearly selected controls carry the hierarchy.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: A primary action using the active palette.
components.css: .ds-primary { background:var(--primary,#326b58);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff);border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;font:500 13px "IBM Plex Sans Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#51836c);outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Search field
components.html: <input class="ds-search" placeholder="Find a setting…" aria-label="Find a setting">
components.css: .ds-search { padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input,#d9dfd7);background:var(--background,#fcfcfa);color:var(--foreground,#252a27);border-radius:7px;font:13px "IBM Plex Sans Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-search:hover { border-color:var(--ring,#51836c); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#51836c);outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Selected navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { height:36px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--sidebar-accent,#dfe9df);color:var(--sidebar-accent-foreground,#254c39);border:0;border-radius:7px;font:600 13px "IBM Plex Sans Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-nav:hover { filter:brightness(.97); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#51836c);outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: File row
components.description: Full-width, compact file navigation with a divider.
components.css: .ds-file { display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;width:100%;padding:18px 16px;text-align:left;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#e1e5df);background:var(--background,#fcfcfa);color:var(--foreground,#252a27);font:500 14px "IBM Plex Sans Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-file span { font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#626b64); } .ds-file:hover { background:var(--muted,#eff1ed); } .ds-file:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#51836c);outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Reading typeface
components.description: Native font selector with the reading preview alongside it.
components.html: <select class="ds-typeface" aria-label="Reading typeface"><option>Grotesk + Merriweather</option><option>IBM Plex Sans</option></select>
components.css: .ds-typeface { width:100%;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--input,#d9dfd7);border-radius:7px;background:var(--background,#fcfcfa);color:var(--foreground,#252a27);font:14px "IBM Plex Sans Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-typeface:hover { border-color:var(--ring,#51836c); } .ds-typeface:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#51836c);outline-offset:3px; }
